protocol.workload: One new saved daily input window at hour 0. Both periodic schedules refresh unconditionally at their ticks. The input-change policy refreshes on a new model/window/horizon key. Four logical checkpoints share the current input.
protocol.timing: Accelerated desktop replay. First refresh timings are descriptive wall-clock measurements through the forecast handler after warmup, including UI updates.
protocol.scope: FP32 TensorFlow.js CPU graphs with saved ERA5-Land input cases. Forecast parity and executed graph calls.
